role: In-memory test double for GraphPersistence and BehavioralStore protocols
detail: InMemoryGraphPersistence is a complete, working test implementation backed entirely by plain Python dicts and lists. It stores nodes and edges (KnowledgeNode, KnowledgeEdge) with upsert semantics, implements node/edge CRUD, AND-semantics filtering (NodeFilter, EdgeFilter), temporal window queries on valid_from (half-open [start,end)), cosine similarity search from raw vectors, schema evolution (type splits with INSTANCE_OF/SPLIT_FROM edges), property expectations in a separate dict with HAS_EXPECTATION edge tracking, and all six behavioral data types as append-only lists (ProposalOutcome, CorrectionEvent, VerificationResult, GapLifecycleEvent, SessionSummary, BehavioralBaseline). Key algorithm: get_similar_to_cluster computes connected components via BFS over SIMILAR_TO edges, filters by label_raw, computes centroid/session_ids/contrast_ratio for each cluster, and cross-cluster similarity between pairs. Also stores primitive symbols (Conversation Engine Phase 1) and grounding failures (Phase 2) in separate dicts. Upsert idempotence, in-place updates on node/edge overwrite, zero-magnitude embeddings return 0.0 similarity. Removes incident edges on node delete. All methods are async but non-blocking (in-memory only).
gotchas: Not thread-safe. Zero-magnitude embeddings match nothing (returns 0.0 not NaN). Dimension mismatches skip nodes silently. No referential integrity enforcement on edges (can dangle). Graph connections SIMILAR_TO use both directions (A->B and B->A counted as one pair via normalization). Primitive symbols and grounding failures stored separately from node graph. Does not persist across process restart. Scales only to thousands of nodes/edges. _closed flag set by close() but not enforced on subsequent calls.
